title: On Responsible Machine Learning Datasets with Fairness, Privacy, and Regulatory Norms
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes a framework to evaluate datasets. It mentions 'religious beliefs' as an example of sensitive data in a proposed datasheet template, but does not measure or analyze any aspect of religion in its evaluation of 60 datasets.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its analysis focuses on fairness, privacy, and regulatory compliance with respect to demographics like age, gender, ethnicity, and skin tone in biometric and medical datasets.
